subject: PlatinumMetrics onboarding — order form, exhibits & billing entity
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: PlatinumMetrics: order form draft + party sheet (intake)

Team — following today’s discovery call with PlatinumMetrics, attaching the initial Order Form and their party sheet. They’ve indicated they want a single Order Form + Exhibit A (usage tiers) and an IP carve-out for their pre-existing models. Key asks from the customer:

- Confirm billing entity (they currently route invoices to procurement@platinummetrics.com)
- Keep the indemnity cap at 1x for their initial pilot but accept our standard auditor carve (they asked if SOC evidence is required)
- Quick DPA addendum to match Redwood template; they may request a data residency note for EU customers later

Attachments: Platinum_OrderForm_v1.docx, Party_Sheet.xlsx

Can legal take a look at the Order Form for required redlines on IP/indemnity and confirm whether we can accept a 1x cap for this pilot? Hannah — if procurement signs a PO, can you confirm timeline for billing setup and whether we need any additional billing fields in the Order Form?

I’d like to send a consolidated list of asks back to the customer by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0102

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PlatinumMetrics: order form draft + party sheet (intake)

Thanks for the context — I reviewed the draft quickly and flagged the items that will need redlines. High-level:

- IP: we can keep our standard language but add a narrow customer-hosted-model exception. Need customer to confirm the scope of pre-existing models (names/IDs) in the party sheet.
- Indemnity & cap: 1x is below our default threshold for commercial customers. For a short pilot (<90 days) we can provisionally agree to 1x provided we: (a) limit it to direct damages, and (b) add a mutual knowledge threshold for third-party claims. I will draft conditional language.
- DPA/Residency: recommend attaching our standard DPA as Exhibit C and include a checkbox in the Order Form for EU processing. If customer later requires region-specific hosting, escalate to Private deployment team.

I attached a redline PDF (Platinum_OrderForm_v1_redline.pdf) with inline comments. Two asks for Karthik: please confirm the billing entity (legal name exactly as appears on their PO) and provide the list of pre-existing model identifiers in Party_Sheet.xlsx so I can narrow the carve.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PlatinumMetrics: order form draft + party sheet (intake)

Looping in billing/process details — small checklist so we can avoid rework:

- Confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on invoices (w/ EIN if US).
- Determine PO number format and whether they require W-9 or tax form.
- For monthly usage invoicing we need: billing contact name, billing email, mailing address, and GL code (if they have one). If they want Net 45 vs Net 30, that’s a commercial decision but please flag now.

I prepared a quick billing matrix (billing_matrix.csv) mapping our invoice fields to their party sheet — once you confirm entity I’ll pre-populate and send to procurement. For the DocuSign flow: we can do Order Form + DPA in one envelope. Share the HubSpot deal link if you want me to push the envelope.

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Contracts & Billing | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@platinummetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: PlatinumMetrics: follow-up — billing entity, model IDs, SOC2

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the call. Marissa and Hannah had a few clarifying questions before we send a consolidated redline:

1) Billing entity: please confirm the exact legal name to appear on the invoice and whether procurement@platinummetrics.com is the correct invoice receipt address. If there’s a PO number, please send a sample format (e.g., PO-####).
2) Pre-existing models: Marissa needs the list of model names or IDs you referenced on the call so she can scope the IP exception precisely. A short column in the Party_Sheet.xlsx is fine.
3) SOC 2: do you need SOC 2 Type II evidence for the pilot? If yes, we’ll attach our SOC 2 snapshot and may require a slightly longer procurement timeline.

I attached an updated Party_Sheet.xlsx with a new column for model IDs and a quick mapping. Once we have answers to 1–3, Marissa will send a redline and Hannah will circulate a populated billing_matrix.csv. If all looks good on your side we can do Order Form + DPA in the same DocuSign envelope and I’ll include the HubSpot deal link so teams can track.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks — look forward to your replies.
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Khan <aisha@platinummetrics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@platinummetrics.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PlatinumMetrics: follow-up — billing entity, model IDs, SOC2

Karthik — thanks. Answers below and attaching the signed PO.

1) Billing entity: Platinum Metrics, Inc. (EIN: 27-3456789). Please send invoices to procurement@platinummetrics.com. PO number format: PM-2026-78921. Attached: PO_78921.pdf
2) Model IDs: Added column "Model_Repo_ID" to Party_Sheet.xlsx and filled three entries (PM-Model-A, PM-Model-B, PM-Model-C).
3) SOC 2: yes, we need SOC 2 Type II for the pilot. We can accept a SOC snapshot and do a 30-day procurement window.

We’re happy to proceed with your redlines. Please send the DocuSign envelope when ready.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Procurement | Platinum Metrics
aisha@platinummetrics.com
